Two-stage reveal on click

Clicking the trigger immediately toggles a class on itself (simulating an optimistic loading state, the way a real app disables/spins a submit button right away), then only after a longer delay replaces the real content - mirroring an async fetch-then-render flow (click -> network call -> re-render). A settle-wait that returns on the *first* detected DOM change would catch the class toggle and miss the real content entirely (see wiki/crawl4ai-integration-pitfalls.md's hydration-wait entry for the original, single-stage version of this bug this fixture extends).
